philosophy.title: Design Philosophy
items: My design philosophy dey grounded for clarity, intention, and usability. I believe say good design suppose feel obvious—e no be say e easy, but because e well structured and e get sense.
I dey prioritize to solve the right problem before I focus on fine-fine. Visual polish important, but only after layout, hierarchy, and usability don settle.
I dey design with the understanding say users no dey read interfaces well-well—dem dey scan am. Na this one dey guide how I structure dashboards and organize content.
I also dey think beyond single screens and focus on systems. Consistent components, spacing rules, and typography scales dey improve both user experience and team efficiency.
Above all, I see design as continuous learning process, wey we dey refine through feedback, iteration, and real-world application.

about.title: About Qomardeen Tijani — Product Designer
about.subtitle: Product Designer wey dey build digital products wey fit grow and wey focus on users.
about.p1: I be Product Designer wey dey build digital products wey clear, well arranged and get big impact for SaaS platforms, internal tools and things wey regular people dey use. I dey join product thinking, UX reasoning and strong visual work to design interfaces wey dey help users finish their tasks sharp-sharp and with confidence.
about.p2: I dey see design as way to solve wahala. Before I enter high-fidelity design, I dey first understand wetin users want, how dem dey work, di limits and di rare cases, so dat di solutions go easy to understand, dey well arranged and fit grow as di product dey grow.
about.p3: My experience cover CMMS platforms, dashboards, fintech products and website design. I don ship live digital products from start to finish, from research and discovery go wireframes, visual design and handoff to developers, with strong focus on landing pages wey dey convert and product flows wey join well.
about.p4: Before I move fully enter product design, I work for fashion design, where I learn how to balance beauty with structure, limits and wetin users dey expect. Dat foundation sharpen how I dey think for systems and how I dey notice small things, wey now dey direct my digital work.
about.p5: I dey actively look for product design role where I fit contribute sharp-sharp, work close with different teams and continue to do work wey get impact.
about.job1Desc: I design onboarding, wallet management and payment screens for fintech app, with research, wireframes and prototypes to make hard money processes simple and reduce wahala during transactions.
about.job2Desc: I lead di UX/UI design from start to finish for one CMMS platform — research, wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes for Figma — plus landing pages and di main product structure for login, payments and support. I work with project managers and engineers for one Agile team to speed up delivery.
about.job3Promo: Dem promote me from Project Manager Intern (2023–2024)
about.job3Desc: I dey handle project planning, timelines and delivery across different teams, dey keep scope, budget and quality for track. I introduce well-arranged workflows and reports wey make execution easy to predict and make stakeholders see wetin dey happen, while I dey handle client communication, resources and risk from kickoff reach handover.
about.job4Desc: I lead creative direction, production and delivery to clients
